title: Enterprise Connectivity: assisted price selection
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this assisted price selection rule to accepted-source pricing.

## Basis: reduction
For accepted-source pricing, for a holding with eligible promotion, use the larger of its campaign reduction fraction and the Support fraction; otherwise use the smaller of the Network tier portfolio reduction fraction and the Support fraction. Approved negotiated and committed pricing remain outside this assisted on-demand route. For this qualifying assisted on-demand source, select this fraction independently of unreduced monthly portfolio usage subtotal and portfolio spending threshold; the ordinary portfolio eligibility test and price precedence do not select a competing price. This fraction applies only to the primary net service subtotal and gives no cash credit or reduction of ancillary fees or tax.

## Hypothetical branch comparison
Assume hypothetical campaign, Network portfolio and Support fractions of 0.06, 0.03 and 0.04. Eligible campaign status selects 0.06. Otherwise the selected fraction is 0.03. The two branches select a fraction rather than adding fractions.
